method: Bounded read-only ghidra-cli decompilation and instruction listings from the identified analyzed program established the wrapper representation. The callback, Lua type handling and failure facts were read from instruction listings decoded directly from the PE bytes through the section table, after the executable byte size and full SHA-256 were verified. Callers were found by scanning .text for rel32 call and jmp instructions, so virtual and indirect callers are not covered. The output table was read as four little-endian DWORDs at VA 0x00D09F90 through the authenticated PE section map after another full size/hash check. Current Ghidra FileBytes and loaded-image contents were not freshly compared with the executable. Addresses are absolute virtual addresses.
scope: Generic _progFunc registration, captured dispatch, bounded input/output representation, the Lua type handling of each input position, the installed callback with its operation ids, and the failure behavior of a rejected argument. The language meaning of operation 3 is INFERRED and the CRT parsers are not traced.
evidenceTier: MIXED, see tierVocabulary and the tier of each fact
tagDomains: VM tags at selected-value offset 8 and internal marshalling record tags at record offset 8 are distinct domains. Equal numeric tags are not equated across those domains. VM tags are the Lua 5.1 type codes: 0 nil, 1 boolean, 3 number, 4 string, 5 table, 6 closure and 7 userdata are STATIC from the stores at 0x00DCE150, 0x00DCE360, 0x00DCE170, 0x00DCF0EF, 0x00DCD972, 0x00DCE349 and 0x00DCED22. 2 light userdata and 8 thread are INFERRED from the Lua 5.1 code assignment. The type reader 0x00DCDCE0 returns -1 for an index past the stack. Internal record tags are 0 boolean byte, 1 unset, 2 signed 32-bit and 3 float32.

observations.claim: Registration requests eight bytes, writes native arguments at payload offsets 0 and 4, and supplies implementation 0x00D09CD0 with capture count 1.

Invocation selects computed index -0x2713 and loads the first captured payload when the current closure header permits it. Payload offset 4 is called with payload offset 0 and local marshalling storage.

registrationAndDispatch.inference: The inspected wrapper instructions dispatch through a captured native identity. Those instructions perform neither positional-string operation selection nor operation-specific closure construction. This statement does not constrain untraced callees or the bound callback.
registrationAndDispatch.limitation: This join is conditional on the current closure header permitting capture 1. FUN_00DD6040 constructor/header semantics, actual bound callbacks, allocator internals, and global installation internals remain untraced.

inputLoop.claim: The loop examines positions 1 through min(current stack-slot count, 8). Zero positions still reach dispatch.

representation.claim: Raw VM tag 3 is accepted directly. Another tag is accepted only when FUN_00DDE8B0 returns nonzero.
The numeric primitive supplies a double from a raw VM-tag-3 or converted payload. Its conversion failure path returns x87 zero.

The classifier first requires raw VM tag 3, then tests an ordered equal comparison between the numeric value and a qword produced through FUN_009D6636. The marshalling path calls FUN_009D6600 and stores a 32-bit payload with internal tag 2.
representation.limitation: The conversion helpers are CRT code. Their overflow behavior is recorded in integerConversion and their internals are not traced.

representation.claim: The numeric value is narrowed to float32 and stored with internal tag 3.

representation.branch: First predicate rejected, selected VM tag 1
representation.claim: The second conversion normalizes the selected DWORD payload to 0 or 1 and stores a byte payload with internal tag 0.
The input record retains its initialized internal-tag-1, self-pointer, zero-byte default.

truthPrimitive.claim: The primitive returns 0 for selected VM tag 0 or selected VM tag 1 with zero DWORD payload. It returns 1 otherwise. The second input predicate restricts its relevant marshalling use to VM tag 1 after the first predicate rejects the input.

inputLoop.limitation: This is a bounded representation contract with the Lua type handling in luaTypeHandling. It is not an operation-specific argument signature.

steps.step: First predicate 0x00CF36E0 calls 0x00DCDD50. It returns 1 for VM tag 3 and otherwise 1 when FUN_00DDE8B0 succeeds on the slot. FUN_00DDE8B0 returns the slot for tag 3, runs the string conversion for tag 4 and returns zero for every other tag. It writes into a 16-byte local, so no Lua stack value is mutated.

A position the first predicate accepts takes the classifier 0x00CF3670. It is true only when the raw VM tag is 3 and the number equals its 64-bit truncation. True stores a signed 32-bit payload with internal tag 2. False stores a float32 narrowing with internal tag 3.
A position the first predicate rejects takes 0x00CF3700, true only for VM tag 1. True stores the normalized 0-or-1 byte with internal tag 0. False leaves the initialized unset record.

perType.luaValue: nil, light userdata, table, function, userdata, thread
number with an integral value inside the int64 range
other number: fraction, NaN, infinity or beyond int64
string FUN_00DDE8B0 converts, such as "7" or "7.5"
perType.record: internal tag 3, float32, never tag 2, because the classifier tests the raw VM tag

perType.luaValue: string FUN_00DDE8B0 rejects, such as "abc" or ""

luaTypeHandling.extraArguments: Positions past 8 are never examined. A nil in the middle keeps its position and stays unset.

stringConversion.claim: FUN_00DDE8B0 has the shape of the Lua 5.1 value-to-number conversion and 0x00DDE360 the shape of the Lua 5.1 string-to-number routine. The routine calls the CRT floating-point parser 0x009DBB7B and rejects the string when the stop pointer equals the start. When the stop character is x or X it reparses through the CRT integer parser 0x009D8B4C with base 16, adds 2^32 to a result negative as signed 32-bit, and takes that call's stop pointer. It accepts when the stop character is the terminator, otherwise it skips characters the CRT class helper 0x009D825A accepts (taken as white space, INFERRED) and accepts only when the stop character is then the terminator.
stringConversion.limitation: The CRT parser grammar for decimal, exponent, leading white space and inf or nan text is not traced.

integerConversion.claim: The payload comes from 0x009D6600. A nonzero CRT flag at 0x0137B8E8 selects cvttsd2si, which returns 0x80000000 outside the signed 32-bit range. A zero flag falls through to 0x009D6636 and the EAX result is the payload. The flag is taken as the SSE2 availability flag (INFERRED) and its initial value is not traced. The classifier uses ordered equality against the 64-bit truncation, so NaN, infinities and magnitudes beyond int64 are float32 records.

localDefaults.claim: Eight input records and four result records have internal tag 1. Each 12-byte record points from offset 4 to its own zero byte at offset 0. Result records begin at local base+0x60.
localDefaults.emittedDefault: On the normal path, every untouched result record selects the internal-tag-1 case, which emits one VM-tag-0 stack slot without writing its payload bytes.

outputCases.observation: The byte at the result payload pointer is zero-extended and normalized to 0 or 1. The core writes that DWORD and VM tag 1 at the current stack top, then advances the top by 16 bytes.
The state-only adapter calls the default core. It writes VM tag 0 at the current stack top, writes no payload bytes, and advances the top by 16 bytes.
The signed-32 value at the result payload pointer is converted to double. The shared adapter/core writes that double and VM tag 3 at the current stack top, then advances the top by 16 bytes.
The float32 value at the result payload pointer is widened to double. The shared adapter/core writes that double and VM tag 3 at the current stack top, then advances the top by 16 bytes.

outputTable.boundary: The four-DWORD PE metadata read verifies the canonical executable size and SHA-256 before resolving the table.

outputAndReturnConstraints.claim: Each well-formed supported internal output tag 0, 1, 2, or 3 selects one verified push that adds 16 bytes to the stack top. Four supported result records therefore emit four new stack slots on the normal path.
An internal output tag outside 0 through 3 skips insertion for that record. This is distinct from initialized internal tag 1.
The normal native return declares 4 results independently of the number of insertion paths taken.

limitations: Semantic internal marshalling tag names remain unpromoted. The representation and normalization operations are directly observed.

The CRT parsers 0x009DBB7B and 0x009D8B4C, the class helper 0x009D825A and the truncation helper 0x009D6636 are named by call shape and not traced internally. The decimal and exponent grammar, inf and nan text, floating-point environment behavior and the initial value of the flag at 0x0137B8E8 are open.
The kinds that operations 0 and 1 accept, the role of the slot table at owner +0x4DC and the classes the factory builds are not traced beyond the factory switch range.

Signed or negative hex strings such as -0x10 are undetermined because the CRT integer parser sign and prefix handling is not traced. A parser for anything beyond plain unsigned 0x<hex> is a CALIBRATION question.
The language enumeration, the sources behind 0x004055D0 and the writers of the user-config record at group 0 key 0x19 are not traced.
Whether an engine frame above the Lua VM catches the std::bad_cast, and what the client does when none does, is not traced.
FUN_00DD6040 capture-header semantics, allocator internals and global installation internals remain unknown.
Global installation internals, initializer environment, host-locale rules and private decoded Lua remain excluded.
No target execution, live retail session, network validation, or client acceptance was performed.

tierVocabulary.STATIC: Read directly from instructions or data at the cited addresses.
tierVocabulary.INFERRED: A name or role taken from surrounding instructions or from a tracked catalog that the bytes do not state.

registration.claim: The registration site passes object 0 and function 0x0075CE70 through the thunk 0x00CC9B00 to 0x00CD7920, so the payload holds 0 and 0x0075CE70.

adapter.claim: 0x0075CE70 is a cdecl function that ignores its first argument. It loads the global pointer at 0x0134BB00, takes the sub-object at +0x54C through 0x004D7480 and calls 0x0059F680 on it with the marshalling storage. The setter 0x0075CE90 writes the global and is called at 0x0057AABB.

owner.claim: The sub-object constructor 0x0059F600 stores its owner at +4, and the object constructor 0x004DBF40 builds the sub-object at +0x54C and stores two constructor arguments at +0x4F4 and +0x4F8. The global is therefore an object of the class that 0x004DBF40 constructs. FUN_004D73B0 is recorded as the +0x4F4 getter by manifests/0x00D6_state_flag_pipeline.json step4.

function.claim: Reads the first input record as an integer operation id and dispatches on it. Every integer read checks the record's internal tag against 2 first. Operations 0, 1 and 3 exist. Any other value returns without touching a result record. Only operation 3 writes a result record, so a call returns one number and three nils for id 3 and four nils otherwise.

operations.inputs: record 1 must be an integer (internal tag 2), record 2 is an optional integer that defaults to -1 when its tag is not 2
operations.effect: Calls 0x0066ECA0 on the table at owner +0x4DC. It allocates an object of the requested kind through the factory 0x0066DD00, which switches on kinds 0 through 0x73, constructs it through 0x004FFCF0, stores it at table +0xC4 + 4*kind and sets bit 0 of object +0x224. A record 2 other than -1 passes the object already in that slot to the constructor. The factory range-checks the kind (cmp ecx, 0x73; ja at 0x0066DD26) and its default arm at 0x0066E7E4 is untraced. The existing-slot load at 0x0066ECB1 and the table store at 0x0066ECCE are not bounds-checked.

Calls 0x0066F620, which returns without effect when the slot is empty (0x0066F62C..0x0066F632). Otherwise it clears table slot +0xC4 + 4*kind and bit 0 of object +0x224, hands the object to the list at table +0x2A8 through 0x0066FF30 and destroys it through 0x005065B0. The slot load is not bounds-checked.
Reads the object at owner +0x4F4 through 0x004D73B0, reads its DWORD at +0x20 through 0x004B68A0 and writes it to result record 0 through 0x0052EB70, which stores the value with internal tag 2.

callback.tableRole: The slot table at owner +0x4DC and the kinds are taken as an object manager and are not traced further.

callSites.claim: The corpus records one _progFunc call site, global_u line 268, inside the _getLanguage inline wrapper. The operation id that call passes is not decoded here because the script body is excluded. Operation 3 is the only operation that writes a result. Operations 0 and 1 have no recorded Lua call site.

operationThreeValue.tier: STATIC for the access chain, INFERRED for the language meaning
operationThreeValue.claim: The DWORD is a field at +0x20 of an object that 0x004B2DF0 receives as its second argument and passes through 0x004DC3A0 to the constructor 0x004DBF40, which stores it at owner +0x4F4. The field has the getter 0x004B68A0, the setter 0x004B6890 and the predicate 0x004B68B0, true when the field is 4 or 5. The setter has one caller, at 0x00402D63 inside FUN_00402B30. That caller reads the user-config lookup 0x00443E40 with group 0, key 0x19 and default 0. A nonzero result minus 1 becomes the field, otherwise the field is the return of 0x004055D0. That function reads a five-byte file and accepts its first byte when it is below 6, then falls back to a registry lookup and a further path (INFERRED from the size and read calls).
operationThreeValue.languageMeaning: The 4-or-5 predicate matches DesktopWidget.isChinese, which tests _getLanguage() for 4 or 5 (xivl-client-scripts:docs/chocobo-mount-script-contracts.md, Naming widget). That the field is the language selector is INFERRED from the predicate, that script check and the _getLanguage name. That the object at +0x4F4 is the one 0x00402D63 writes is INFERRED from the shared class accessors. The enumeration of the other values, the file, registry key and final path behind 0x004055D0 are not traced.
operationThreeValue.nativeConfigAddress: The native lookup 0x00443E40 addresses group*32 + (key & 0x1F), so the record is native group 0 key 0x19. The Lua-facing one-based addressing of _getUserConfig reaches it as group 1 key 26.

failureBehavior.tier: STATIC for the throw and the handler tables, INFERRED for the protected-call use
failureBehavior.claim: A failed integer check in the callback builds a std::bad_cast with the message bad cast (string 0x00F91C08, throw info 0x011B31F8, catchable types std::bad_cast and std::exception) and throws it through 0x009D1B9F, taken as the CRT throw routine (INFERRED). The wrapper frame 0x00D09CD0 has a function info with zero try blocks. The Lua protected-call primitive 0x00DCF140 has one try block whose only handler type is the pointer type lua_longjmp (type descriptor 0x0131DF00, handler 0x00DCF18F, function info 0x0125F128). std::bad_cast does not match it, so a Lua pcall around the call does not catch the exception and it unwinds past the Lua VM. Whether an engine frame above the VM catches it is not traced.
failureBehavior.wrapperOutputChecks: The wrapper's own output-tag mismatch checks at 0x00D09F37, 0x00D09F54 and 0x00D09F71 throw the same exception. The setter 0x0052EB70 writes tag 2 with the value, so the callback does not reach them.
